note: Føroya Banki's price book for the Faroe Islands (in force from 25 September 2026): a monthly account fee of 20 kroner on a private customer's first account, waived for customers under 29 and for those with deposits or custody holdings over 10,000 kroner (written as a balance never below 10,000.01); the waivers for senior customers (no age given) and salary accounts aren't written.

sources.title: Føroya Banki, Prísbók Føroyar (in force from 25 September 2026)
sources.said: Prísbók Føroyar Galdandi frá 25. september 2026 ... Føroya Banki P/F ... Mánaðarligt kontugjald - fyrsta konta 20 kr. ... Kundar undir 29 ár, seniorkundar, kundar við lønarkonto og kundar við innlánum ella goymsluvirði yvir 10.000 kr. eru undantikin kontugjaldinum.
